title: AAT Accounts Assistant - Practice
description:
Overview

Our client as leading independent firm of Chartered Accountants is looking to recruit an AAT Accounts Assistant with the enthusiasm to join its busy small business accounts and VAT department.

This is a varied role to primarily include bookkeeping and VAT work for clients as well as accounts and Tax Return preparation for a varied portfolio of sole traders, partnerships and small limited companies.

Responsibilities
- Bookkeeping
- VAT Returns
- Accounts preparation
- Personal and Corporation tax computations
- Tax Returns - Self Assessment and Company
- Working to tight deadlines

Experience & Skills
- AAT qualification or proven experience in a similar role
- Excellent communication skills
- Experience gained in an accountancy practice
- Strong bookkeeping and accounts preparation skills
- Working knowledge of preparing Tax Returns
- Good IT skills which must include Excel and Word and either SAGE, QuickBooks or Xero

On offer
- Competitive salary - depending on skills and experience
- Study Support
- Contributory pension and life insurance scheme
- Flexible working including Flexitime system
- Annual leave of 25 days, plus bank holidays (full time equivalent)
- Modern and friendly working environment
- Convenient office location with easily accessible car parking nearby (currently free of charge)
- Structured CPD, training and development programme
- Professional subscriptions reimbursement
- Employee Assistance Programme

title: Accounts Receivable Administrator
description:
Role: Accounts Receivable Administrator

Location: Hessle, HU13

Are you a proactive and driven Accounts Receivable Administrator with great communication skills? Can you manage and support company credit control by taking responsibility for your own book of debtor accounts?

Then Scientific Laboratory Supplies (SLS) is the right fit for you. Join us and contribute to our mission of being the UK's largest independent supplier of laboratory equipment, chemicals, and consumables.

We have an exciting opportunity available for a Credit Controller to join our finance team based in Hessle, HU13, on a full-time, permanent basis.

Job Summary:

The Accounts Receivable Administrator will join the SLS Finance team and contribute to all areas within the finance function. The successful candidate will be asked to support the busy credit control function in the office but must be willing to provide support as needed to other areas of the finance function which will include communicating with colleagues, external parties, customers, and vendors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take a proactive role in managing and supporting company credit control by taking responsibility for own book of debtor accounts.
- Use all forms of communication (email, letters, and telephone) to professionally contact debtors and ensure payment of outstanding invoices.
- Support the ongoing process of credit checking new customers and open new credit accounts ensuring the company has all the relevant information.
- Support and resolve all problems experienced in the credit control function including providing copy invoices, obtaining proof of delivery.
- Work closely with colleagues in Sales and Customer Services to resolve any customer queries and enquiries to progress matters to a satisfactory conclusion.
- Report regularly to the Accounts Office Manager on outstanding issues and promptly inform them of potential debtors' problems.
- When required, help colleagues to manage the "slsledger" email inbox, resolving enquiries quickly and effectively and to pass enquiries onto colleagues in both Finance and other departments for resolution.
- Maintain financial system records and enter data accurately.

Perform general clerical duties when required, including, but not limited to, typing, mailing, filing correspondence and answering telephone calls.

Ideal Candidate:
- Prior experience of working in a credit control / accounts receivable function.
- Comfortable with IT.
- Strong literacy and numeracy skills.
- Interpersonal skills, appreciation of good internal and external customer service behaviour.
- Be organised, methodical, self-motivated, and driven.
- Responsive and re-active.
- Good customer-facing and personal relationship skills.
- Be able to communicate at all levels.
- Ability to work within a flexible team.

About us:

SLS are the UK's largest independent supplier of laboratory equipment, chemicals, and consumables. Because of our independence, we have a unique approach to sourcing and supplying the highest quality, best value products, and brands. Supplying to a wide range of sectors, provides a diverse and interesting customer base as well as providing countless opportunity to grow and expand.

With customers all over the UK, we are a stable and growing company who have an excellent reputation in the market.

We are passionate about our people and have developed a strong team dynamic who are welcoming and supportive of new individuals, joining the company with a brilliant management team to support you as you find your feet in the role.

We are also proud to be a Living Wage Employer and committed to equal opportunities and actively promote a diverse and inclusive working environment, and fairness for everyone.

Alongside our commitment to your professional and personal development, we also offer a generous benefits package including:
- Competitive salary
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Company pension
- Enhanced Maternity and Paternity leave
- Small, friendly, and sociable teams with staff events
- Company profit bonus schemes
- Cycle 2work schemes
- Career opportunities for development and progression

title: Payroll Processor
description:
Payroll Processor

Based in the accessible town of Goole, this full-time permanent role as a Payroll Processor offers the opportunity to join a supportive and friendly team.

Working Monday to Friday, with the possibility of part-time hours being considered, this position provides a competitive salary alongside a range of benefits, including a contributory pension and life insurance scheme, a Flexitime system, and 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays. The role is based in a convenient office location with nearby free parking.

As a Payroll Processor, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of payrolls for a range of clients. Working within a collaborative and deadline-driven environment, you will help maintain our reputation for excellent client service while contributing to the smooth operation of payroll functions.

Essential Skills and Qualifications
- Minimum of one year s experience in payroll processing and associated tasks
- Knowledge of Auto Enrolment processes
- Competent in using computer systems and payroll software
- Strong numeracy skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team

Why Join Us?
- Be part of a purpose-driven organisation with a commitment to quality and impact
- Enjoy a competitive salary, contributory pension, and life insurance scheme
- Benefit from flexible working options, including a Flexitime system, and opportunities for professional growth
- Work in a convenient office location with free parking and a supportive team environment
- Access our Employee Assistance Programme for wellbeing support

Interested in joining our team at Townends Accountants LLP? If so, why not get in touch today!

Reference: SE4292

Vacancy: Payroll Processor

Location: Goole

Salary: Competitive salary

Hours: Full Time Monday to Friday (Part Time may be considered)

Smart Hire are advertising on behalf of Townends Accountants LLP.

title: Temporary Bookkeeper
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and adaptable Bookkeeper looking for a hands-on role within a small business? Are you used to a stand alone position where you can support the finance function and look at ways to make efficiencies? Are you immediately available and able to work in a temporary contract for a well established business who need additional support to process a backlog of work in the first instance.

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturer based in the Bridlington area, is seeking a temporary Bookkeeper to join their team and support them with a backlog of accounts work.

They are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take on a crucial role, providing essential financial support and contributing to the smooth operation of the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid bookkeeping experience, particularly with Sage, who is eager to become an integral part of a hands-on SME.

What the Bookkeeper job involves

You'll play a key role in managing the daily financial operations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
- Raising customer invoices and delivery notes on a daily basis.
- Managing the invoice factoring process.
- Daily monitoring of bank accounts and cashflow.
- Payroll administration, collating employee hours each week from a clocking in system and send to payroll.
- Matching invoices and accurately allocating payments within Sage.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who enjoys being at the heart of an operational team, managing multiple financial priorities, and providing excellent administrative support.

Skills required

We're looking for candidates who can demonstrate a practical approach and a willingness to contribute beyond traditional bookkeeping duties. Ideal candidates will have:
- Proven experience with Sage 50 would be beneficial.
- The ability to manage and allocate payments efficiently within Sage.
- Self managed and able to work on their own initiative.
- A high degree of adaptability and flexibility to take on a range of tasks as needed.
- Previous experience in bookkeeping from a small / medium size business.

This role would suit someone who is not afraid to contribute to a busy, hands-on environment.

Other information
- Working hours are initially 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.
- On-site car parking available.
- Own transport is essential due to the location.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

KD Recruitment Limited is committed to a policy of equal opportunities in relation to job applications and we are also committed to protecting your personal data. If you would like to read our privacy policy, please go to our website where you will find all the information you need to know about how we will use and process your personal data.

You can also follow us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn for up to date jobs and other helpful information.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
A well established and successful company in Hull is looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Assistant to complement their established team. This part time position has varied duties including ledgers, credit control, banking, month end, cashiering and providing assistance to the Financial Controller, though this list is not exhaustive. Varied accounts knowledge is required and you must also possess professionalism, high levels of accuracy and a strong work ethic.
THE ROLE:
Part time hours, office based, permanent.
To work alongside a professional team processing ledger invoices, reconciliations, credit control, banking, month end and performing cashiering duties.
Assist the accounts management team with additional tasks.
Identify, investigate and resolve all account queries.
Above average IT literacy including Microsoft Word & Excel.
THE CANDIDATE:
Must have the ability to process ledger invoices, reconciliations, credit control, banking, month end and cashiering processes.
Possess commercial awareness and intuition to identify and solve accounts related queries.
Show a willingness to assist others in the team.
Able to remain calm, focused and accurate whilst striving towards deadlines.
Confidence to liaise with internal and external contacts.
THE BENEFITS:
Salary: 28,000 - 30,000
Established company, accessible via public transport
THE CONSULTANCY:
Edwards & Pearce acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. Edwards & Pearce is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
A very successful company in Hull would like to add an additional Purchase Ledger Clerk to their current accounts support team. This role requires a candidate with extensive experience with all aspects of accounts payable as you will be overseeing a large ledger processing high volume invoices. You must therefore have the ability to manage and prioritise your workload by being pro active and meticulous.
THE ROLE:
Full time, permanent, office based.
Manage all aspects of a high volume purchase ledger.
Matching, batching, coding and reconciling invoices before undertaking payment runs.
Liaise with suppliers and colleagues to solve account related queries.
Friendly, supportive company with good staff retention.
THE CANDIDATE:
Must have extensive experience with all aspects of purchase ledger processing high volume invoices.
Confidence and accuracy when working towards deadlines.
Be assertive when liaising with suppliers and colleagues to solve account queries.
Strong personality, highly organised and able to manage a busy workload.
Knowledge of CIS would be an advantage, but not essential.
Above average IT literacy especially Excel.
THE BENEFITS:
Salary: 30,000 - 33,000
Progressive working environment, welcoming colleagues
The Consultancy:
